Quick-mode triage is done. One of the 17 open tickets was a quick win, and I added it to the queue at priority 5 (the ticket has no priority of its own):

- [Give every ticket that has no Topics line one, from its title and TLDR](tickets/2026-09-22_topics-for-untopiced-tickets.md) (effort 1, uncertainty 2)

Reading the queue back shows that entry as the only one. The other 16 tickets have effort or uncertainty above 2, so quick mode leaves them out.

Separately, the Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until you do that.
